CLAUDE.md – sportyR

Source: CLAUDE.md

Repo-specific rules. The shared commit/PR/safety rules live in .claude/CLAUDE.md (synced across repos – edit the template in ClaudeCowork, not that file).

sportyR draws scaled ggplot2 playing surfaces per rule-book dimensions. CRAN maintainer (cre) is Ross Drucker: we prepare releases, he runs devtools::submit_cran() and answers CRAN’s confirmation email. Never submit.

Sports (geom_*())

baseball, basketball, curling, football, hockey, lacrosse, soccer, softball (2.3.0, NCAA), tennis, volleyball. Each has R/geom-<sport>.R (exported geom_<sport>(league, display_range, field_updates, color_updates, rotation, x_trans, y_trans, <surface>_units, xlims, ylims)) and R/features-<sport>.R (internal feature functions). cani_plot_sport(), cani_plot_league() and cani_color_league_features() read the same data.

Data pipeline (data-raw -> sysdata)

  • Source of truth: data-raw/surface-dimensions.json (all dimensions, league codes, default colors).
  • data-raw/internal-datasets.R (working dir = repo root) rebuilds R/sysdata.rda (surface_dimensions, internal). Never hand-edit the .rda.
  • New league/sport: edit the JSON, re-run the script, add feature functions, geom_*(), tests, _pkgdown.yml reference entry, NEWS, README table.

Downstream ports (vendor the JSON)

  • sportypy (Python) and sdvplot-js (packages/sporty, fixtures under fixtures/sporty/) vendor surface-dimensions.json. A geometry change here means re-vendoring there (sdvplot-js: pnpm vendor, pnpm oracle:sporty). sdvplot / sdvplotR consume surfaces via those ports.

Conventions

  • roxygen2 8.1.0 (devtools::document()); never hand-edit man/ or NAMESPACE. Every exported fn needs @return and @examples; existing examples sit in \dontrun{}.
  • README.Rmd is the source; devtools::build_readme() renders README.md (revert re-rendered man/figures/*.png unless figures changed).
  • Tests: tests/testthat/test-*.R, skip_on_cran() is the first line of every file; CI sets NOT_CRAN: true so they still run (R-hub and covr too).
  • Windows R: use the newest install (C:/Program Files/R/R-4.6.x/bin/Rscript.exe).
  • LF line endings.

CRAN prep checklist

devtools::check(args = "--as-cran") -> 0/0/0; urlchecker::url_check(); pkgdown::check_pkgdown(); win-builder (check_win_devel() / check_win_release() email the maintainer) and R-hub (.github/workflows/rhub.yaml, manual dispatch); update NEWS.md and cran-comments.md. CRAN-SUBMISSION is written by submit_cran() and stays buildignored – do not edit it.
